inspection_summary: Inspected all 1,530 logical lines. The note reduces critical-line and simple-zero proportions to a smoothed mollified moment for a three-piece mollifier, audits admissible piece lengths, evaluates the square through shifted second/third/fourth moments, and derives the new third-piece terms by Euler products, contour residues, differential operators, and symmetry recombination. The normalized prose is coherent; displayed formulas have layout noise but the mathematical roles and transformations are recoverable. The advertised improvement remains conditional on the explicitly unproved twisted-third-moment Theorem 5.1.
